title: Emmy Noether: Polno medžuslovjansko izdanje korpusa / Complete Interslavic Corpus Edition
description:
Medžuslovjansky

Čitajte polny povezany medžuslovjansky PDF-čitateljnik — latinica i kirilica · dostati PDF-fajl.

Glavny cělj tutogo izdanja jest praktično čitanje ljudmi, ktori govoret slovjanskymi jezykami, vključajuči čitateljev bez anglijskogo jezyka; ono ne jest samo lingvističny eksperiment. To jest polno medžuslovjansko izdanje korpusa Emmy Noether: statje 1–43, lekcijsko dělo 44, statja 45 i bibliografija. Latinica jest glavno-redakcijny jezyčny tekst; kirilica jest deterministično izvedeny drugy zapis togo samogo teksta, a ne oddělny prěklad ili nezavisny svědok.

Popravka v020. Latiničny kanon jest bajt-po-bajtu jednakovy s v019. Vseh 4 560 naslědženyh zapisov rolij bylo pregledano; 364 nepravilne klasifikacije byly popravljene i osam nedostajučih granic imen bylo dodano. Vseh 372 efektov bylo prověrjeno: 346 ohranjajut tekst i 26 projektujut tekst. Izvod změnil 125 linij, vse izključivo v 309 dozvoljenyh iztočnikovyh linijah; latinične fajly ne sut změnjene. Projektor v7 jest fail-closed i ohranjaje pregledane imena, originalne naslove i citaty, rimske označenja, bibliografične elementy i TeX-sintaksu.

Versija i povtorimost. Točny DOI tutogo izdanja NOETHER-ISV-v020 jest 10.5281/zenodo.22058530; stabilny DOI koncepta jest 10.5281/zenodo.21926382. Latiničny tekst ostavaje na redakcijnom čelu ISV019-EDIT-0171. Vse 171 materialne latinične redakcijne rěšenja i novy polny pregled projekcijnyh rolij, iztočniki, odklonjene alternativy i kontrolne sumy sut v javnom paketu.

Sodržanje. Javna versija imaje četyri jasne produkty: polny povezany čitateljnik (1 159 stranic), redagovateljne iztočnikove fajly, arhiv dokazov i pohođenja s publikacijskoju metodologijeju, i spisok SHA-256. Mašinno-čitljivy CANON_INDEX.json označaje latiničny tekst kako jezyčny kanon i kiriličny tekst kako izvedenu projekciju, da by druga sesija mogla povtoriti ili prodolžiti rabotu bez izmysljenja konkurentnogo kanona. Strukturna kontrola imaje 38 uspěšnyh kontrol i nula pogrěšek; vizualna kontrola pokryvaje vseh 86 izměnjenyh kiriličnyh stranic i 103 susědne neizměnjene kontrolne stranice.

Status recenzije. To jest naučno rabotno izdanje, izrabotano modelami/agentami s mašinnoju pomočju. Ono ne prošlo nezavisnu naučnu recenziju i ne tvrdži, že jest potvrđeno rodnymi govoriteljami, medžuslovjanskoju obćinoju, oficialnym standardom ili nezavisnoju institucijeju.

English

Read the complete linked Interslavic PDF — Latin and Cyrillic · download the PDF.

The primary purpose of this edition is practical reading by people who speak Slavic languages, including readers without English; it is not merely a linguistic experiment. This is the complete Interslavic edition of Emmy Noether's corpus: Papers 1–43, lecture work 44, Paper 45, and the bibliography. Latin is the canonical editorial language text; Cyrillic is a deterministically derived representation of the same text, not a separate translation or independent witness.

v020 correction. The Latin canon is byte-for-byte identical to v019. All 4,560 inherited role records were reviewed; 364 misclassifications were corrected and eight missing name boundaries were added. All 372 effects were verified: 346 preservation decisions and 26 projection decisions. The derivation changed 125 lines, all exclusively within 309 licensed source lines; no Latin source byte changed. The v7 projector fails closed and preserves reviewed names, original titles and quotations, Roman labels, bibliographic forms, and TeX syntax.

Version and reproducibility. The exact DOI for NOETHER-ISV-v020 is 10.5281/zenodo.22058530; the stable concept DOI is 10.5281/zenodo.21926382. The Latin text remains at editorial head ISV019-EDIT-0171. All 171 material Latin editorial decisions and the new exhaustive projection-role review, sources, rejected alternatives, and cryptographic identities are included in the public package.

Contents. The public release has four clear products: the 1,159-page complete linked reader, editable sources, an evidence/provenance archive containing the publication-style methods paper, and a top-level SHA-256 manifest. Machine-readable CANON_INDEX.json identifies the Latin text as the language canon and Cyrillic as a derived projection so another session can reproduce or extend the work without inventing a competing canon. Structural QA reports 38 passing checks and zero errors; visual QA covers all 86 changed Cyrillic pages and 103 adjacent unchanged controls.

Review status. This is a scholarly working edition produced by models/agents with machine assistance. It has not undergone independent scholarly peer review and does not claim certification by native speakers, the Interslavic community, an official standard, or an independent institution.
